summary: Backend marketplace regression tests passed 4/4. UI browsing, search, profile gallery, chat modal, and mobile overflow checks executed; two integration/protection gaps found.

integration_issues.issue: Unauthenticated /customer/dashboard renders the dashboard and empty state instead of redirecting to login or showing an unauthorized state. The API call is silently swallowed.
Chat modal appends messages only to local React state and never calls /api/chat/messages; the apparent successful send is mocked/local.
Favorite state is local-only and booking CTA only shows a toast; neither persists or calls backend booking/favorite APIs.
AuthCallback navigates to dashboard regardless of /api/auth/session success or failure, so invalid/failed callback sessions are not surfaced.

action_items: Protect /customer/dashboard at the router/UI level and show login/error state when /api/dashboard/summary returns 401.
Wire chat send/load to /api/chat/messages and provide auth/error handling.
Implement persistence or clearly disable/mock-label favorite and booking actions.
Handle OAuth session exchange errors before redirecting to the dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth callback ignores fetch response status and unconditionally redirects, masking OAuth failures.
Dashboard catch(() => {}) hides protected API errors and renders plausible zero-state data to unauthenticated users.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ photographer registration was created through the public API to verify account masking; no cleanup endpoint was available.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public API, search/filter, profile/gallery, chat modal, and mobile overflow were tested. Full Google OAuth browser completion was not run because no OAuth test credentials/session were available. Payment is intentionally deferred/mock.
rca of the issue: The dashboard component never redirects based on auth state and suppresses get() errors. Chat/profile actions are implemented as local state/toast handlers rather than backend calls. AuthCallback's promise has no response check or catch before nav().
